import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    score_feed = inputs["score_feed"]
    score_snapshot_old = inputs["score_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: STG_CURR
    stg_curr = (
        score_feed.groupby("account_id", as_index=False)["score"]
        .mean()
        .rename(columns={"score": "avg_score"})
    )

    # Step 2: DELTA - computed against OLD snapshot (pre-update)
    merged = stg_curr.merge(
        score_snapshot_old[["account_id", "avg_score"]],
        on="account_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_prev"),
    )
    merged["avg_score_prev"] = merged["avg_score_prev"].fillna(0)
    merged["score_delta"] = merged["avg_score"] - merged["avg_score_prev"]

    delta = merged[["account_id", "score_delta"]].copy()

    # Step 3: SCORE_SNAPSHOT replaced with STG_CURR (post-update state)
    score_snapshot_new = stg_curr[["account_id", "avg_score"]].copy()

    return {
        "delta": delta,
        "score_snapshot": score_snapshot_new,
    }
